## NBL Player Salary: A Benchmark for Professional Sport

The **NBL player salary** for the 2026-27 season has been set with a 7% increase, reflecting the league's growth and commitment to player compensation. According to the NBL's Salary and Contracting Rules, the minimum salary is $88,754.76, the salary cap is $2,167,358.92, and the salary floor (the minimum each team must spend) is $1,950,642.53. These figures provide a useful benchmark for understanding professional athlete earnings in Australia, especially when compared to the national minimum wage and average earnings.

For context, the national minimum wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for a 38-hour week. That works out to an annual salary of about $52,269.44. The NBL minimum is well above this, but it's still below the ABS average weekly earnings for full-time adult employees, which is $2,083.70 per week (approximately $108,352.40 per year).

## Converting Hourly Rates to Annual Salary

Whether you're an NBL player on a contract or an employee earning an hourly wage, the basic conversion from hourly to annual is the same: multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work per week, then multiply by 52 weeks. For a standard full-time role, we assume 38 hours per week (the ordinary hours used in the national minimum wage).

For example, the national minimum wage of $26.44 per hour gives:
- Weekly: $26.44 × 38 = $1,004.72 (close to the official $1,004.90)
- Fortnightly: $1,004.72 × 2 = $2,009.44
- Annual: $1,004.72 × 52 = $52,245.44 (the official figure is $52,254.80 using the exact weekly rate)

If you have a salary offer, you can reverse the calculation: divide the annual salary by 52 to get weekly, then divide by your weekly hours to find the equivalent hourly rate. Use [the timesheet](/) to quickly convert between hourly and annual figures.

## Tax and Superannuation on Your Salary

Once you have your annual gross salary, the next step is understanding tax and super. For the 2026-27 financial year, the resident tax rates are:
- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Plus, the Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income (with reductions for low-income earners). For an NBL player earning the minimum $88,754.76, the tax would be approximately:
- $0 on $18,200
- 15% on $26,800 ($18,201 to $45,000) = $4,020
- 30% on $43,754.76 ($45,001 to $88,754.76) = $13,126.43
- Total tax: $17,146.43
- Medicare levy (2%): $1,775.10
- Total deductions: $18,921.53
- Net annual take-home: about $69,833.23

Superannuation guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary by your employer. For the NBL minimum salary, that's $88,754.76 × 12% = $10,650.57 per year, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. From 1 July 2026, employers must pay super at the same time as wages (Payday Super).

For a more detailed breakdown of your own figures, see [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) and [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging).

## Casual Loading and Award Rates

It's important to distinguish between the national minimum wage, award rates, and enterprise agreements like those covering NBL players. The national minimum wage applies to employees not covered by an award or agreement. Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the minimum wage, making the casual rate $33.05 per hour. However, NBL players are employed under a specific enterprise agreement, so their pay is governed by the NBL Salary and Contracting Rules, not the national minimum wage or a modern award.

If you're a casual worker in another industry, you can use [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) to calculate your total hourly rate including the 25% loading. Remember: never type a rate that already includes casual loading into the timesheet; instead, enter the base rate and tick the casual loading checkbox.

## How the NBL Salary Compares

The NBL minimum salary of $88,754.76 is a solid professional wage, but it's worth noting that it's below the ABS average full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $108,352.40 per year. However, many NBL players earn above the minimum, with marquee players earning up to $535,121.73 (Marquee 4). The salary cap ensures competitive balance while allowing teams to invest in talent.

For context, the national minimum wage annual equivalent is about $52,269.44. So an NBL player on the minimum earns about 70% more than someone on the national minimum wage. But compared to the average full-time worker, the NBL minimum is about 18% lower. This reflects the relatively small size of the league and the fact that many players supplement their income with overseas contracts or other work.

If you're comparing a job offer or considering a career in professional sport, use [average pay](/topics/average-pay) and [job pay](/topics/job-pay) to see how different industries stack up. And remember that the figures here are estimates based on standard assumptions; your actual pay and tax may vary depending on your specific circumstances.

For more detailed conversion tools and reference tables, visit [reference tables](/data) and [pay guides](/blog).
